# Controller 1.0.51 (100)
Siri, Mac Live Activities, touch on Mac, and Cursor and Pi updates for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android.
- On iPhone and iPad with the iOS 27.3 Siri AI Developer Preview, Siri can list the Controller chats that need you, recap a chat, read its pending requests, open it, draft a prompt for review, or send a follow-up after you confirm the chat and text. Unsent drafts stay untouched. Sending a follow-up needs this version on the Mac too. - On macOS 27.3 and later, a Live Activity shows when a thread on this Mac is working or waiting for you, in the menu bar or Dynamic Island on supported hardware. - On a Mac with a touch screen, scrub the reasoning effort slider with your finger, tap away to dismiss the plan, and press and hold tabs, history entries and the send button for their actions. Model picker targets are larger on Mac, iPhone and iPad. - Cursor accounts now use version 1.3.0 of Cursor's SDK. Settings offers the new download. When a Cursor run fails, the thread now shows Cursor's message. - Managed Pi accounts now use Pi 1.5.0. If you use Pi's Azure provider, it is now named `azure`: rename `azure-openai-responses` in your Pi configuration or run `/login` again.

# Controller 1.0.51 (98)
Settings and SwiftDroid updates for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android.
- Settings has been rebuilt on the Mac and iPhone with unified cards and search that reaches individual settings. - SwiftDroid threads can now choose a reasoning effort. The composer offers the levels each model supports, and your choice applies to Builds and every Mission stage, including from a paired device. - When a direct Gemini request goes silent before its first response, SwiftDroid waits longer and retries once. If it still times out, the thread says so and you can continue to try again. - Factory Droid SDK accounts now use version 0.10.0 of Factory's SDK.

# Controller 1.0.51 (97)
SwiftDroid and Factory Droid updates for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android.
- Add SwiftDroid in Mac Settings and connect it to ChatGPT, Gemini, the Anthropic API, or your installed Claude Code. Choose a model from the connected account and start a Build or a resumable Mission. - Use a paired iPhone, iPad, or Android device to follow SwiftDroid progress, respond to approvals, send follow-ups, stop work, and return to the same conversation. Provider credentials stay on the Mac. - Factory Droid SDK accounts can run Workstreams and configure role models and validation stages. - Finished conversations release their managed worktrees.
